text.p: Trade was active on Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady on live basis sales, dressed basis steady to $1.00 per cwt lower. Buyer inquiry and demand good. Seller interest good.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs 63.00-64.00; Dressed basis 102.00 to mostly 103.00. ( weighted average 102.62).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 63.00-64.00; Dressed basis 102.00 to mostly 103.00. ( weighted average 102.62).
